stage: 1 synthetic and metadata gates, then 2 central historical profile system only; no Stage3 grid
samples: all 35 FRESNO/FINE, original 20 fitting species; no date or fit-quality selection
physical_mass_upper_panel: NOT RUN: original mass-uncertainty/partition metadata is not established by this protocol
bounds: exact rational values parsed directly from original decimal strings; L=max(0,f-k*uF), U=f+k*uF, l=c-k*uc, u=c+k*uc; fixed_profile uses L=U=f
validation: all nominal selected profile abundances nonnegative; uc>0; uF>=0; finite; reject missing/sentinel values; do not normalize or cap profile columns
mass_band: 4/5*TMAC <= sum(s) <= 6/5*TMAC; diagnostic sensitivity only, not physical conservation or confidence interval
crosscheck_solver: highs-ipm for every successful linear-objective optimization before decision classification
near_zero_decision_margin: 1e-7*max(1,TMAC); an exact positive bound below this threshold is labeled near-zero HOLD, not a practically robust order
exact_primal_check: first verify Fraction(str(float solver value)); if unsuccessful, repair using one deterministic greedy exact independent active-constraint basis on positive support; active shortlist relative slack<=1e-7; retain unresolved if no exact feasible point found
exact_dual_check: clip positive minimization inequality marginals to zero, represent as exact rationals, derive residual-corrected lower bound using only independently valid finite source upper bounds from nonnegative L rows or declared mass upper; if correction requires missing bound, no rigorous lower bound
infeasibility: solver status alone is NUMERICALLY_UNRESOLVED; require exact Farkas y>=0, G^T*y>=0, h^T*y<0, obtained from separate phase-I LP and independently checked or exact-active-basis repaired
unboundedness: require exact feasible point and exact recession ray d>=0, G*d<=0, q*d<0; seek ray with sum(d)<=1; otherwise NUMERICALLY_UNRESOLVED
co_leader: one joint feasible point with s_a>=s_b for every other b; not separate pairwise possibilities
outputs: source lower/upper verified bounds, pairwise bounds, possible co-leaders, verified witnesses/certificates, infeasible/unbounded/nearzero/numerically-unresolved states; all denominators retained
cache: identical exact rational model/objective requests may reuse identical computed certificates; universe labels and all sample denominators remain separate
limitations: known interval/set-membership mathematics; independent entrywise boxes; no statistical coverage or physical attainability of every box member; per-sample latent profiles may differ; no manuscript/baseline promotion
